measurement.comparisonPolicy: Use equal-length pre/post windows bounded by actualCoverageStart; do not compare a partial 8.54-day first-party baseline against a nominal 30-day window.
notes: Search Console was unavailable, so this baseline uses first-party click/session data only.
Review snapshots should record requestedWindowDays, actualCoverageStart, actualCoverageDays, and the concrete pre/post timestamps used.
Exclude or annotate QA/internal sessions when they can be identified.

searchConsole.implication: No account-level impressions, CTR or average-position data used in this wave

prePostComparison.warning: firstPartyWindowDays is the requested lookback, not the actual collector coverage.

priorityPages.note: new in Phase 2; baseline starts at zero

optimizationHypotheses: Match title promises to actual numbered content to improve trust and reduce pogo-sticking
Lead titles with the primary query intent and keep priority titles within a compact SERP-friendly range
Use answer-first summaries and visible freshness to increase snippet relevance
Strengthen contextual internal links from high-authority hub/home pages to priority landing pages
Separate incident-response intent from prevention/recognition intent to reduce cannibalization
